description: This Java class 'JobParameterDataParser' is responsible for parsing JSON-formatted request bodies to extract job parameters into a set of JobParameterDTO objects. It leverages Gson for JSON parsing and includes methods to safely handle blank or null inputs.

classes.name: JobParameterDataParser
classes.description: A Spring component class that parses JSON request bodies for job parameters.

methods.name: parseExecution
methods.description: Parses the input requestBody string as JSON, extracts the 'jobParameters' array, and returns a set of JobParameterDTO objects with parameter names and values.
